work_orders.title: Re-establish and live-verify Hermes pairing
work_orders.problem: Historical deployment evidence does not prove a current Hermes service, pairing, provider path, or external receipt flow.
evidence: fresh doctor, health, and reality checks
historical Hermes ADRs and deployment records
work_orders.current_state: Hermes is configured only as a mock/unavailable path in fresh local checks and is not LIVE_VERIFIED.
work_orders.target_state: A bounded Hermes node passes authenticated pairing, proposal-only authority, timeout, audit, and rollback tests.
work_orders.rollback: Disable the external pairing and restore the local stub path; preserve receipts.

work_orders.title: Define the Engineering Finding and review/diagnostic coordination plane
work_orders.problem: Atlas has verifiers, diagnosis, production, audit, events, and rollback components but no unified engineering finding contract or coordinator.
evidence: SelfAuditRunner, EventBus, Merkle, Golden Route, and ColdUpdate
work_orders.current_state: Specialized findings and verification loops exist without one serializable projection or end-to-end Orchestrator channel.
work_orders.target_state: EngineeringFinding, ReviewCoordinator, DiagnosticCoordinator, persistence, events, adapters, and contract tests compose existing capabilities.
tests: no patch application from a finding
risks: creating another verifier instead of composing existing ones
work_orders.rollback: Disable coordinator wiring while preserving specialized verifiers and immutable findings.
dependencies: operator acceptance of ATLAS DEFINITIVE CANDIDATE
acceptance: proposals still pass governed approval paths

work_orders.title: Execute comprehensive CodeOSS/VSCodium/Void Workbench convergence
work_orders.problem: The accepted desktop host and donor capabilities are not yet integrated into one maintained Atlas product.
evidence: VSCodium build and privacy pipeline research
work_orders.current_state: Host and donor sources are preserved but not wired into the definitive candidate.
work_orders.target_state: A professional Atlas Workbench compiles reproducibly and projects real Cut 1 contracts through narrow Atlas seams.
scope: privacy, branding, Open VSX, update, and packaging
review, diagnosis, approval, and operations surfaces
tests: change to finding to proposal to approval to receipt E2E
work_orders.rollback: Restore the last pinned compilable host and disable Atlas contribution seams independently.
dependencies: exact CodeOSS and VSCodium upstream pins
acceptance: exact scope approved in the Cut 2 design

work_orders.title: Assimilate compatible Zed ACP capabilities and interaction patterns
work_orders.problem: Zed provides useful ACP and agentic patterns but a source transplant would create license and stack coupling.
work_orders.current_state: Zed is a pinned pattern donor and interoperability target, not Atlas implementation.
work_orders.target_state: Relevant behavior is represented by ACP interoperability, requirements, contract tests, or separately licensed components.
work_orders.rollback: Remove optional adapters or requirements without changing Atlas Core authorities.
acceptance: every selected pattern has measured value and lawful disposition

work_orders.title: Select and implement the dedicated Android Workbench projection
work_orders.problem: ADR-071 requires Android, while ADR-078 deliberately selects only the desktop host and cannot make CodeOSS an Android implementation.
work_orders.current_state: Android remains an accepted target without a selected projection or implementation.
work_orders.target_state: A dedicated Android surface consumes stable Atlas contracts without introducing a second runtime authority.
tests: mission, finding, approval, and receipt projection
work_orders.rollback: Remove the Android projection while preserving Surface API and desktop Workbench.

work_orders.title: Decide durable Mission, Task, and orchestration authority
work_orders.problem: Mission is the accepted semantic unit, but durable task ownership and the Mission-to-Task boundary remain ambiguous.
evidence: current orchestrator and task persistence code
work_orders.current_state: Multiple components participate in task lifecycle; no final service boundary has operator authority.
work_orders.target_state: One mutable-state owner with explicit Mission, Task, Orchestrator, Policy, and Evidence interfaces.
tests: contract tests after the boundary ADR is accepted
work_orders.rollback: Retain current APIs and introduce no migration until an accepted ADR defines compatibility.

work_orders.title: Decide memory ownership and promotion paths
work_orders.problem: SQLite, BlockMemory, Kuzu, vault, semantic knowledge, and Evidence have use-case authorities but no final promotion and sharing map.
work_orders.current_state: Use-case-specific stores exist and are tested; cross-store promotion authority is not settled.
work_orders.target_state: An operator-approved ownership map preserves private distillation, provenance, retention, deletion, and shared-graph boundaries.
tests: promotion provenance tests after the authority ADR is accepted
work_orders.rollback: Preserve ADR-057 use-case authorities and prohibit new automatic promotion.

work_orders.title: Authorize Wave 5 Native substrate work
work_orders.problem: Native-kernel work lacks demonstrated Hosted limitations, a complete threat model, portability evidence, migration design, and authorization.
source_decisions: current operator directive invariants and completion conditions
work_orders.current_state: Hosted Linux is the operational substrate; Native is research and Wave 5 is conditional.
work_orders.target_state: Native work begins only after all constitutional gates and rollback criteria are approved.
work_orders.rollback: Continue Hosted-first delivery; no Native implementation is introduced.
acceptance: operator approves a bounded implementation order

work_orders.title: Select the Membrane and Osmosis enforcement profile
work_orders.problem: Research supports bilateral auditing and provenance filters, but optional gateway versus non-bypass enforcement changes product guarantees.
work_orders.current_state: Membrane and Osmosis are first-class research/program lines; no general enforcement deployment is accepted.
work_orders.target_state: Operator-approved guarantee profile, bypass semantics, trust boundary, and rollback.
tests: bypass and fail-closed conformance after acceptance
work_orders.rollback: Keep research and adapters separate from core enforcement.
acceptance: deployment mode and guarantee profile accepted by ADR

work_orders.title: Implement autonomous adoption of remote executable MCP packages
work_orders.problem: Automatic remote executable adoption would weaken human control over high-sensitivity third-party effects.
work_orders.current_state: Remote executable auto-adoption is absent and blocked.
work_orders.target_state: Remain absent unless a future constitutional ADR explicitly supersedes the rejection.
tests: canonical validator rejects any accepted or implemented disposition for ADR-076 C
work_orders.rollback: Not applicable; no implementation is authorized.

work_orders.title: Resolve the Atlas API bridge mutation boundary
work_orders.problem: ADR-058 and ADR-071 define port 7341 as a read-only projection, while the current server exposes mutating POST routes including task approval that executes the Atlas CLI.
work_orders.current_state: Code is present, tested, wired, and contradicted by its accepted bridge boundary; no later ADR authorizes the expansion.
work_orders.target_state: An operator-approved ADR either authorizes governed mutation contracts or restores a strictly read-only bridge.
tests: contract and authorization tests after the boundary decision
risks: product clients depending on an unaccepted contract
work_orders.rollback: Preserve current code without widening it; do not remove routes or declare them canonical until the operator chooses the boundary.
acceptance: mutating endpoints have explicit authority, authentication, audit, and rollback, or are removed
ADR-058 and ADR-071 receive scoped supersession if mutation is accepted
